name: Alpsee
kurzbeschreibung: Lake Alpsee and the Bärenbad lido in Berwang at 1,336 metres offer idyllic shoreline strolls, heated open-air pools, and alpine recreation in the Zugspitz Arena.
beschreibung:
Überblick

The natural waters of Lake Alpsee alongside the adjacent Bärenbad forest swimming lido form a tranquil leisure haven in Berwang, the highest village in the Tiroler Zugspitz Arena at 1,336 metres above sea level. Cradled within a sunny, wind-sheltered high valley between the limestone spires of the Lechtal Alps and the iconic Zugspitze massif, this scenic area provides a restful escape for wellness seekers and family adventurers alike. Lake Alpsee captivates visitors with crystal-clear emerald waters fed by alpine mountain springs, shaded lakeside trails, and sensitive wetland habitats that shelter native mountain amphibians and colorful dragonflies. Immediately adjacent, the Bärenbad complex features heated outdoor pools, current channels, and sprawling sunbathing lawns framed by rugged mountain ridges.

Route & Anforderungen

The pathways surrounding Lake Alpsee and the sports park are distinguished by gentle gradients and easy accessibility. The peaceful circular trail looping the lake spans approximately two kilometres and can be enjoyed in about 45 minutes of easy strolling. Its wide, crushed-gravel footpaths are fully barrier-free and well-suited for all-terrain strollers. Shaded wooden rest benches and lakeside viewing platforms provide ideal spots for nature watching and photography. Hikers seeking longer excursions can follow the bubbling stream along the valley floor to Bichlbach or ascend towards the cozy Kögelehütte alpine pasture. Light walking shoes or comfortable sneakers are ideal for the lake path, while supportive hiking boots are recommended for connecting hillside trails.

Besuch & Anreise

Travel by road from the north is toll-free via Garmisch-Partenkirchen and Ehrwald, or from Füssen via Reutte along federal highway B179 to Bichlbach, where provincial road L21 branches into the high valley of Berwang. Free parking spaces are available directly beside the Bärenbad recreational center. Train passengers take the scenic Außerfernbahn railway to Bichlbach-Berwang station, connecting with local VVT bus shuttles running right to Berwang center.

Tipps

Combine your serene lakeside walk with a match on the immaculate miniature golf course or clay tennis courts located within the Bärenbad park. Following your swim, the lakeside pavilion terrace serves chilled drinks, artisan ice cream, and traditional Tyrolean afternoon snacks with panoramic mountain views.
preis: Lakeshore trails freely accessible; Bärenbad swimming pool charges entry
oeffnungszeiten: Lake trails open year-round; swimming facilities operate late May to early September
